name: News Element – Magazine Blocks, Theme Builder, Mega Menu & Starter Sites
author: webangon

sections.description:
News Element turns the block editor into a newsroom. It adds 83 news, magazine and blog blocks to Gutenberg, plus everything around them that a publisher needs: a theme builder for the header, footer, single post and archive, a mega menu built from blocks, a Global Kit of colours and fonts, and a Demo Library that imports a complete starter site in one click.

There is no page builder underneath. The blocks save standard block markup, work with any theme and look best on a blank one.

Plugin page · Browse the starter sites · Get Pro

Starter sites: 147 home pages across 13 news sites

Open News Element → Demo Library, preview any home on desktop, tablet and phone, then import the site around it: pages, posts, categories, Theme Builder templates, menus and the Global Kit. 85 home pages are free; Pro adds 62 more.

  • Frontline – breaking news and current affairs (19 homes)
  • Broadsheet – classic newspaper front pages (18 homes)
  • Personal Blog – personal and lifestyle blogs (17 homes)
  • Journal – long-form magazine and travel writing (16 homes)
  • Circuit – technology news (14 homes)
  • Sports – scores, clubs and match reports (12 homes)
  • Nestwell – home, health and fashion (12 homes)
  • Tickerline – business and markets (10 homes)
  • TechNest – gadgets, reviews and gaming (10 homes)
  • Statecraft – politics and public affairs (10 homes)
  • Marquee – entertainment and pop culture (7 homes)
  • Standard News – a subscription news front page
  • The Spark – a tabloid front page

83 Gutenberg blocks for news and magazine sites

  • Hero blocks – Hero Grid 3, Hero Columns, Hero 50, Hero List Grid, Hero Background, Hero Overlap, Hero Splash, Hero Counter and Timeline Hero.
  • Magazine layouts – twelve magazine blocks (Magazine 9 to Magazine 28) that mix a lead story with lists, grids and overlays.
  • Post grids and lists – Post Grid B to G, Post List, Feature Grid, Feature List, Grid Minimal, Number List, Photo Grid, Image Grid and personal blog layouts.
  • Sliders and carousels – Slider 1, Slider 3, Centered Slider, Vertical Sync Slider, Thumbnail Sync Slider, Slider Nav and Post Carousel.
  • News widgets – News Ticker, Trending, Section Heading, Category Box, Category Pills, Social Followers, Newsletter and Search with live results.
  • Site parts – Nav Menu, Hamburger off-canvas panel, Search, Breadcrumb and Archive Title.
  • Single-post blocks – Post Content, Post Meta, Table of Contents, Author Box, Related Posts, Inline Related, Post Navigation, Comments and Reading Progress.
  • Content blocks – Heading, Button, FAQ, Table, Icon List, Image, Info Box, Star Rating, Video, Pricing Table and Counter.

A grid engine built for front pages

Every post block shares one loop engine.

  • Query by category, tag, author, offset, order or the current archive.
  • 47 loop styles and 7 feature grid layouts: cards, overlays, lists, numbered and counter styles.
  • Category filter tabs that switch topics over AJAX.
  • Six pagination modes: Next / Prev, Load more, Infinite scroll, Numbers, Numbers with reload, or none.

Paywall-ready: premium posts, previews and plans

Run a subscription news site without custom code. When the Metered Content for WooCommerce paywall plugin is active, News Element shows readers which stories are premium and how much they can read before they subscribe.

  • Pro badges on post cards – mark paywalled posts on every post block with eight badge presets (lock, pill, icon, label and more). Set the preset, position, inset and size per block, or once in the Global Kit.
  • Article preview – the Post Content block shows the opening paragraphs of a premium article, then fades them into the paywall box, so readers see what they are unlocking.
  • Paywall designs – pick Classic, Hard paywall, Split panel or Three tiers per block. The plan designs list your access plans with prices, features and “Most popular” / “Best value” badges.
  • Meter summary – the paywall box tells readers how many free articles they have read this period (for example “3 of 3”) and when their allowance resets.
  • Styled with block controls – colours, typography, spacing and buttons of the paywall box are set in the Style tab of the Post Content block, so it matches the rest of the site.

Theme builder

Design the header, footer, single post and archive templates with the same blocks as your pages, then choose where each template shows. Works with any theme; a blank theme gives the cleanest result.

Mega menu

Open full-width panels from any menu item. Each panel is built in the block editor, so it can hold post grids, category tabs, sliders or anything else News Element offers.

Global Kit

Colour and typography presets that every block uses. Change a preset once and the whole site follows. Fonts from Google Fonts can be hosted on your own server.

Fast by default

  • One compiled stylesheet per page, rebuilt on save, with only the CSS of the blocks the page uses.
  • Block scripts load deferred, in the footer, and only on pages that need them.
  • Post images keep the size their block asks for.

Also included

  • Live search: results pop up as readers type.
  • Next post autoload: the next article loads as readers reach the end of one.
  • Author Extras: a local avatar, bio and social profiles for each author.
  • Blank page templates for full-width layouts.

Upgrading from 1.x (Elementor)

News Element 2.0 is a new plugin built for the block editor. It does not contain the Elementor widgets of version 1.x, and pages built with those widgets will not display them after the update. If your site uses the Elementor version, stay on 1.0.9 or test 2.0 on a staging copy first. Version 1.0.9 stays available from the Advanced view of this page.

External services

News Element connects to these services only when you use the feature that needs them:

  • Webangon Demo Library – https://webangon.com/sites/newselement/. When you open News Element → Demo Library, the plugin requests the list of starter sites and their preview images. When you import a site, it downloads that site’s pages, posts, templates, menus, Kit settings and images. No personal data is sent; like every WordPress HTTP request, it carries the standard WordPress user agent, which includes your site’s URL. Service details
  • Google Fonts – https://fonts.googleapis.com and https://fonts.gstatic.com. When you choose a Google font in the Global Kit or a block, the font is loaded from Google, or downloaded once and served from your own site if you turn on local font hosting. Google receives the visitor’s IP address when fonts load from Google. Terms · Privacy policy

sections.installation:
1. In your dashboard go to Plugins → Add New, search for “News Element”, then install and activate it. Or upload the news-element folder to /wp-content/plugins/ and activate it on the Plugins screen.
  2. Open News Element → Demo Library, pick a home page and import it, or start from a blank page.
  3. Add News Element blocks from the block inserter. They are grouped under the News Element categories.
  4. Set your colours and fonts under News Element → Global Kit, and build your header and footer under Theme Builder.
sections.faq:
Does it need Elementor or another page builder?

No. Version 2.0 runs on the WordPress block editor (Gutenberg) only.

Which theme should I use?

News Element works with any theme. Starter sites are designed on a blank theme, because the Theme Builder draws the header, footer, single and archive templates.

Is every block free?

Yes. All 83 blocks, the theme builder, mega menu, Global Kit and 85 starter home pages are free. Pro adds 62 more starter home pages, a year of updates and priority support.

Will importing a starter site delete my content?

No. The importer adds pages, posts, templates and menus next to what you already have.

I used News Element 1.x with Elementor. What happens when I update?

See “Upgrading from 1.x (Elementor)” above. Keep 1.0.9 if your pages rely on the Elementor widgets.

Where can I get help?

Use the support forum or the plugin page.
sections.changelog:
2.0.0

  • New: rebuilt for the block editor. 83 Gutenberg blocks for news, magazine and blog sites.
  • New: Theme Builder for header, footer, single post and archive templates.
  • New: Mega Menu with panels built from blocks.
  • New: Demo Library with 147 starter home pages across 13 news sites.
  • New: Global Kit colour and typography presets, live search, next post autoload and per-page compiled CSS.
  • New: paywall support for Metered Content for WooCommerce – Pro badges on post cards, article preview, meter summary and styled paywall designs.
  • Removed: the Elementor widgets of version 1.x. Version 1.0.9 remains available for Elementor sites.

1.0.9

  • Last Elementor version.
